title: Slow product catalog (400 ms network latency on product-catalog)
hypothesis: 400 ms extra latency on product-catalog slows every journey that reads the catalog by roughly the added latency per call, without errors; home and ads are unaffected; latency returns to baseline within 30 s of rollback.
why: product-catalog has the highest fan-in of any application service (frontend, recommendation and checkout call it) and backs 5 of 7 journeys; latency amplification through repeated calls is a classic cascading-failure path.
